set.description: Sets all blocks in the selected region using a pattern

wand.description: Gives the player a selection wand

thru.description: Moves the player through a targeted wall

ascend.description: Moves the player up a number of levels

descend.description: Moves the player down a number of levels

togglewand.description: Enables or disables the selection wand

copy.description: Copies the selected region to the clipboard

paste.description: Pastes a region from the clipboard

cut.description: Copies and sets the selected region to air

flip.description: Flips the clipboard on an axis

replace.description: Sets all blocks that match the given mask in the selected region using a pattern

walls.description: Creates walls around the selected region using a pattern

stack.description: Repeats the selected region a number of times in a given direction

move.description: Moves the selected region by a given amount in some direction

moves.description: Moves the selected region and shifts the current selection

shift.description: Shifts the current selection by a given amount in some direction

expand.description: Expands the current selection by a given amount in some direction

sphere.description: Creates a filled sphere with a given radius using a pattern

hsphere.description: Creates a hollow sphere with a given radius using a pattern

cyl.description: Creates a filled cylinder with a given radius and height using a pattern

hcyl.description: Creates a hollow cylinder with a given radius and height using a pattern

distr.description: Gets the block distribution in the selected region using the given mask

count.description: Counts the number of blocks in the selected region that match the given mask

trim.description: Minimizes the size of the selection using the given mask

paint.description: Paints all paintable blocks in the selected region to a given color
